 Closings and Delays Enjoy the warmth while you can 
 We will reach into the 60s by this weekend before a cold front moves through. By Kris Hudson Published : Nov. 17, 2026 at 2:20 PM EST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WATERTOWN, New York (WWNY) - Clouds are clearing out this afternoon as temperatures climb into the 50s. 
 Wednesday is looking to be a partly to mostly cloudy day before clouds clear out in the afternoon as highs reach the lower 50s. 
 Thursday highs will be in the upper 50s, but by this weekend we will end up in the 60s. 
 7News Meteorologist Kris Hudson has the latest forecast.
